timeline.text: A stranger could sit in front of our TV and watch free — because the system ignored faces it didn't know.
Meanwhile the one child it recognized was barely in the room.
So now, in that Cloudflare Worker, any unrecognized face gets stopped and asked who it is.
It locks itself out like an unfinished kid, proves it's done with a PIN, or unlocks as a parent.
That stranger sat there four hours; our own kid, just one minute.
